name: rent_roll_units
description: One row per unit from a residential rent roll detail report. The report lists each unit as a block: a unit line followed by its scheduled charge lines (rent, fees, utilities). Fold each block into one row.

property_name.name: Property
property_name.description: Property name from the report header. Same for every row.

report_period.name: Report Period
report_period.description: The month and year the rent roll is for, as YYYY-MM. Same for every row.

unit_number.name: Unit
unit_number.description: The unit identifier exactly as shown in the unit column, e.g. 100-101. One per row.

unit_type_code.name: Unit Type
unit_type_code.description: Floor plan or unit type code for the unit, e.g. C5.

unit_square_feet.name: Square Feet
unit_square_feet.description: Square footage of the unit, as a number.

unit_status.name: Unit Status
unit_status.description: Status of the unit exactly as shown, e.g. 'Occupied No Notice', 'Vacant Unrented', 'Notice Rented'.

resident_name.name: Resident
resident_name.description: Resident name as shown. null for vacant units.

market_rent.name: Market Rent
market_rent.description: Market rent for the unit, as a number.

monthly_rent.name: Scheduled Rent
monthly_rent.description: The scheduled monthly charge on the unit's 'Rent' charge line, as a number. 0 if the unit has no rent charge line.

monthly_other_charges.name: Other Scheduled Charges
monthly_other_charges.description: Sum of all scheduled charge lines for the unit other than Rent (fees, utilities, storage, pet), as a number. 0 if none.

monthly_total_charges.name: Total Scheduled Charges
monthly_total_charges.description: The unit's charge total as shown on its 'Charge Total' line, as a number. Should equal rent plus other charges.

deposit_held.name: Deposit Held
deposit_held.description: Security deposit held for the unit, as a number. 0 if none.

balance.name: Balance
balance.description: Outstanding resident balance for the unit, as a number. Negative numbers stay negative.

move_in_date.name: Move-In Date
move_in_date.description: Move-in date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.

lease_start_date.name: Lease Start
lease_start_date.description: Lease start date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.

lease_end_date.name: Lease End
lease_end_date.description: Lease end date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.

expected_move_out_date.name: Expected Move-Out
expected_move_out_date.description: Expected move-out date, YYYY-MM-DD. null if blank.
